neighbours.label: the same variable or index coming round again in a parallel follow-up expression ('y = ...' then '[y] += ...'; '(a[:, 1] == lo) + (a[:, [1]] == hi)'); silent when the partner (another variable or index) comes instead
fire:
z = k * node.z
            z += h * c * node.dz

height = ratio * img.height
height += margin * img.dh

total = w * item.total
        total += fee * item.extra

depth = f * layer.depth
    depth += g * layer.dd

r = s * atom.r

z = k * node.z
            w = h * c * node.dw

height = ratio * img.height
width = margin * img.dw

total = w * item.total

short: same item again, not its partner
notes: The - pole fires on the partner of a pair (dec after ra, width after length), so this pole reads as the other side: the same member repeated. Probes: repeats 0.19-0.57, partner versions 0.04-0.18 (the 0.18 peaked on '.width' right after 'width =', itself a repeat).
